data.title: Accenture and Anthropic partner to improve AI safety with embedded evualators
data.description:
Accenture (ACN) and Anthropic (ANTHRO) have formed a new partnership to improve the safety of artificial intelligence, with each company pledging to invest at least $1B into the initiative over the next five years.

Shares of Accenture jumped 6% during early post-market trading on Friday.

The companies will deploy a team of embedded evaluators to work with Anthropic's internal teams and safety partners to evaluate and red-team models, conduct alignment assessments and test model safeguards. 

"Accenture is bringing together a dedicated team with deep AI, security and industry expertise to work alongside Anthropic," said Accenture CEO Julie Sweet. "Safety requires both deep technical expertise and a clear understanding of how AI is used in the real world. Embedded evaluation is an emerging area and we look forward to partnering with Anthropic to help accelerate the development of embedded evaluators, which we see as an important part of the safety landscape going forward."

Accenture will lean on its recent acquisition of Faculty, a U.K.-based AI firm, to help in the evaluations. Accenture completed its acquisition of Faculty in March.

"Joining forces with Anthropic as embedded evaluators is exactly the kind of work Faculty was built to do—and as part of Accenture, we have the platform to do it at a scale that can genuinely move the industry," said Accenture Chief Technology Officer Marc Warner.

data.title: Natural Grocers by Vitamin Cottage gains new bull at BofA
data.description:
Natural Grocers by Vitamin Cottage (NGVC) ended Friday’s session with a gain of more than 5% as BofA Securities rated the stock as a Buy to reflect additional margin expansion, opportunities in underserved markets, and an underappreciated value proposition among health-conscious consumers.

 Analyst Vicky Liu believes NGVC’s “Always Affordable” pricing – on average 15% less than Sprouts Farmers Market – should resonate as more financially-pressured health-conscious consumers seek value amidst an increasing inflationary environment.

Moreover, with only 174 stores across 22 states, NGVC remains significantly underpenetrated, and its attractive unit economics allow the company to enter markets that may not support larger specialty grocers.

Liu also sees significant potential in NGVC’s e-commerce opportunities, bolstered by its recent DoorDash (DASH) partnership.

"Natural Grocers by Vitamin Cottage’s replicable small-box format, lean operations, and ability to operate in small markets at a profit will continue to support its competitive pricing model and a higher EBIT margin than conventional grocers," Liu notes.

In addition to rating the stock a Buy, Liu assigns a $35 price target, representing 13% upside to Friday’s closing price.

Shares of Natural Grocers by Vitamin Cottage (NGVC) have gained 24% year-to-date, outperforming the S&P 500 by more than 2x.

data.title: Software lifts Nasdaq even as fed hike, rising yields pressure stocks
data.description:
The Nasdaq Composite (COMP:IND) ended the week at 26,511.01, up 92.72 points, or 0.35%, on Friday, as technology stocks recovered from a midweek selloff as Treasury yields topped 5% and oil prices remained above $100 a barrel.

The index came under pressure on Wednesday after the Federal Reserve raised its policy rate by 25 basis points, its first rate increase since 2023. 

Among the biggest weekly gainers, Strategy (MSTR) rose 17.52% as the SEC's Thursday decision granted temporary conditional relief allowing certain venues to facilitate trading in tokenized U.S. stocks. The regulatory move also lifted other crypto-related stocks.

CrowdStrike (CRWD) gained about 15% during the week, reaching a record high on Monday. The cybersecurity stock was among software names that benefited after AI companies and executives raised concerns about slowing the development of increasingly powerful models, easing some investor concerns about the impact of AI on traditional software businesses. Palo Alto Networks (PANW) and Fortinet (FTNT) also advanced.

Constellation Energy (CEG) was the biggest weekly decliner, falling about 11%, followed by Comcast (CMCSA), down about 10%, and CoreWeave (CRWV), down roughly 9%.Top five weekly gainers: Strategy, CrowdStrike, Palo Alto Networks, Sandisk (SNDK), Fortinet

Top five weekly decliners: Constellation Energy, Comcast, CoreWeave, T-Mobile US (TMUS), Netflix (NFLX)

data.title: Westinghouse seeks $50B-plus valuation in U.S. IPO, targets October filing - Bloomberg
data.description:
Westinghouse Electric is seeking a valuation of more than $50B in its U.S. initial public offering, which it is targeting for as soon as October, although details of the offering including the timing could still change, Bloomberg reported Friday.

Citigroup and Goldman Sachs are leading the IPO, with CIBC, J.P. Morgan Chase, Royal Bank of Canada also working on the listing, according to the report.

Westinghouse is jointly owned by Brookfield Renewable Partners (BEP) (BAM) and Cameco (CCJ), which completed a deal in 2023 to buy a 49% stake in the company at a ~$8B value.

Westinghouse looks set to benefit from the Trump administration's efforts to boost the U.S. nuclear industry, and the U.S. Army recently selected it as one of five firms to build, own, and operate its power plants.

The company's nuclear power technology is used by 57% of the world's nuclear reactors and boasts a pipeline of as many as 91 opportunities for its latest generation reactor.

data.title: Nvidia-backed neocloud Nscale files for IPO
data.description:
The U.K-based neocloud provider Nscale filed its initial public offering prospectus with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission on Friday.

The company applied to appear on the New York Stock Exchange under the ticker NSCL. The filing did not include an expected price range or the number of stocks to be offered. Goldman Sachs (GS), J.P. Morgan (JPM) and Morgan Stanley (MS) will act as lead bookrunners for the proposed offering.

Nscale has data centers in the U.K., Norway and Texas, with several more partner-run data centers operating in Europe and the U.S. 

"We serve some of the largest companies on Earth through strategic partnerships and long-term agreements," Nscale founder and CEO Josh Payne noted in the filing. "This is the foundation that funds the continued buildout of our global footprint, and we believe the opportunity ahead here is vast. With a 10 GW+ portfolio of owned and controlled power, we expect significant expansion in Nscale Infrastructure as we grow with our existing customers, and contract and scale new customers building and delivering frontier intelligence."

As of August 31, 2026, the company's infrastructure portfolio included about 25,000 active GPUs and 461,000 active and contracted GPUs, along with five active and 12 contracted data center sites. What's more, the company had $2.6B of active and $103.4B of active and contracted TCV under long-term take-or-pay contracts with customers, compared to $500M of active and $38B of active and contracted TCV at the end of 2025. Nscale relies almost exclusively on Nvidia (NVDA) GPUs. The company has signifcant contracts with Microsoft (MSFT) and Anthropic (ANTHRO).

Revenue for the first six months of 2026 totaled $140.6M, compared to $10.4M during the same period in 2025. The company also incurred a net loss of $1.02B for the first six months of 2026 due to substantial investments the company has made to grow its platform.

data.title: Trump to 'demand' vaccine makers make smaller doses for kids to address autism
data.description:
• President Trump on Friday told reporters in the Oval Office that he will "demand" that companies that make childhood vaccines manufacture doses that are significantly smaller than currently recommended to cut autism rates. 
  • Speaking at a press conference about expanding "Most Favored Nation" drug pricing to Medicaid recipients in all states, Trump said a recommendation will be made to give childhood vaccines through five shots spaced six-months apart.
  • The president noted that the change would lead to a “massive reduction” in autism cases.
  • Prominent scientific organizations, citing studies, have repeatedly stated that there is no relationship between vaccines and autism. "This has been confirmed through dozens of scientific studies examining different types of vaccines and different vaccine timing schedules," the Autism Science Foundation says.  
  • HHS Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. has been a long-time skeptic of vaccines and has not rejected the vaccines-autism link.
  • In August, Trump signed an executive order that significantly impacts the childhood vaccines schedule, including that the immunizations should be done at multiple medical visits.

data.title: Saratoga Investment CFO steps down for health reasons
data.description:
Saratoga Investments (SAR) Chief Financial Officer Henri Steenkamp will step down from that role  as of Oct. 31, 2026, for health-related reasons, the company said on Friday.

He'll also relinquish his roles as chief compliance officer, treasurer, and secretary on that same date. Steenkamp will continue to serve in a consulting capacity following the transition. He will remain on the company's board and will serve as the CFO of the company's SBIC subsidiaries.

Also effective Oct. 31, 2026, Saratoga Investments (SAR) will promote:

  • Christine Ramdihal to chief accounting officer and treasurer and will serve as the company's principal financial officer.
  • Rochelle Kracoff to chief compliance officer and secretary.
  • James Soltesz to investment manager and vice president of Capital Markets.

Saratoga Investment (SAR) stock edged down 0.2% in after-hours trading.
